user.title: Create a Dew Point helper
user.description: Choose whether to use separate sensors or the temperature and humidity attributes of one weather entity.

data_description.name: A descriptive name for this helper.
data_description.source_type: Use two sensor entities, or read both measurements from a weather entity.

sensors.title: Select sensor sources
sensors.description: Select separate sensors for air temperature and relative humidity. A surface temperature source is optional and enables condensation risk measurements.

data_description.temperature_sensor: The air temperature sensor used for all calculations.
data_description.humidity_sensor: The relative humidity sensor used for all calculations.
data_description.surface_temperature_sensor: The surface temperature to compare with dew point. Leave empty if no surface is monitored.
data_description.condensation_threshold: The surface-to-dew-point margin at or below which condensation risk turns on.
data_description.hysteresis: The additional margin required before condensation risk turns off, preventing rapid switching near the threshold.

weather.title: Select a weather source
weather.description: Use the current temperature and humidity attributes from one weather entity. A surface temperature source is optional and enables condensation risk measurements.

data_description.weather_entity: The weather entity whose current temperature and humidity attributes are used for all calculations.
data_description.surface_temperature_sensor: The surface temperature to compare with dew point. Leave empty if no surface is monitored.
data_description.condensation_threshold: The surface-to-dew-point margin at or below which condensation risk turns on.
data_description.hysteresis: The additional margin required before condensation risk turns off, preventing rapid switching near the threshold.
